values.note: Reserve by phone, 308-631-4700 or 308-631-4478; check in at the Settlers Trading Post. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. ($5 an hour later). Full refund 3 days out, 50% at 2 days, none on the day; no refund for early departure.

booking.source: https://www.chimneyrockpioneercrossing.com/reservations/ ('Your next adventure is only a call away---Let's reserve your spot today! ... Tel: (308)-631-4700 (308)-631-4478'; 'If you cancel 3 days prior to arrival, you receive 100% refund.'), read 2026-11-04

values.note: Full hookup 30 A or 50 A $45 a night for up to four people; $5 per person per night over four (over age 12). Seventh night free on a 6-night stay; monthly $675 (30 days). No tents or dry camping. Read 2026-11-04.

fees.source: https://www.chimneyrockpioneercrossing.com/reservations/ ('Full hookup 30 amp service... $45.00'; 'the parties exceeding four people, there is an additional charge of $5.00 per person per night over 12 years old'; 'Monthly Rate: $675.00 based on 30 days'), read 2026-11-04

note: Private campground in the shadow of Chimney Rock at Hwy 92 & CR 75 east of Bayard, with the Settlers Trading Post (souvenirs, ice cream) on site. Stock pond sits ~400 ft south of the pads (not waterfront). Campendium 4.9 stars. --Claude
summary: Operator site live (home page cites a 2026 event): full hookup 30 or 50 A $45 a night for up to 4 people, by phone, monthly $675 also offered; dump on site. Hookups, dump, booking and fees now manual; site count/lengths unstated by the operator (left derived). Private gate passes ($45, Google 4.5 from 247, website + phone). Pin OK. Note cleaned.
flags: GATE PASSES: posted $45 a night (full hookup 30 or 50 A, up to 4 people; EKKO's two add nothing) - under $50; presence = operator website with rates and two phones; Google Maps 4.5 from 247 reviews; RV Life 4.5 $$. No gateway needed.

LONG-STAY: not long-stay in character - nightly rate posted and reservations by phone; a monthly $675 rate is also offered, but nothing on the pages leads with seasonal or monthly sites. Tests 1-5 pass on what I read.
